name: settleview_order_gate_refusals

query_condition.sql: SELECT code, sum(inc) AS n FROM (SELECT code, max(value) - CASE WHEN min(CAST(start_time AS BIGINT)) >= min(_timestamp) * 1000 - 90000000000 THEN 0 ELSE min(value) END AS inc FROM "settleview_order_gate_decisions" WHERE stage = 'approve' AND result = 'refused' GROUP BY code, __hash__, start_time) GROUP BY code HAVING sum(inc) >= 3

description: Approvals refused by the order gate (3+ in 15 min).

context_attributes.slo: Fewer than 3 approved tickets refused at send time per 15 min.
